correctness.rationale: The quotient of nonzero affine solutions by free F_q^* action gives a projective count. Since d=(q-1)/7 and p does not divide d, the Fermat surface is smooth. All 329 possible multisets of at most four seventh roots have norms exactly 1,8,29,43,64,71,547,729,4096 with multiplicities 91,28,42,42,28,42,42,7,7; hence only six exceptional primes. Residue-field computation of ordered zero-sum tuples yields the six formulas, all checked with pure integer and finite-field modular arithmetic; direct enumeration over F29, F43, F71 independently agrees.
